info.title: OSAS Reference API
info.summary: Governed support agents: the model proposes, the policy engine decides.
info.description: HTTP surface of the Open Support Agent Spec reference implementation (specVersion 0.2). components.schemas are the authoritative JSON Schemas from schemas/ — the same source the runtime validator uses. Auth: demo mode uses x-osas-role / x-osas-actor-id / x-tenant-id headers; jwt mode uses OIDC Bearer tokens. All errors use the Error component.

core.common.title: OSAS common definitions
core.common.description: Shared $defs reused across all OSAS schemas via relative $ref.

actionDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical stable-JSON serialization of { actionType, params } of the approved proposal (RFC 0008). Recomputed and verified at execution time.

costUsd.description: USD cost; absent = unknown (no price configured). Never fabricated.

sequence.description: 1-based position in the tenant's audit hash chain (v0.1.1 extension)

previousHash.description: eventHash of the previous event in the chain; genesis uses 64 zeros

eventHash.description: SHA-256 over the stable JSON of this event with eventHash excluded

core.capability-manifest.title: CapabilityManifest
core.capability-manifest.description: What an OSAS implementation actually supports (introduced in v0.1.1; part of specVersion "0.2"). Served at GET /.well-known/osas and GET /v1/capabilities; operations needing an undeclared capability fail with CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED.

core.shadow-run.title: ShadowRun
core.shadow-run.description: Shadow Mode record (v0.1.1 Milestone 3): the simulated policy decision for one proposal, whether it would have auto-executed, and the eventual human outcome. Shadow Mode never executes the suggested action and never marks the proposal executed.

core.shadow-metrics.title: ShadowMetrics
core.shadow-metrics.description: Shadow Mode operational metrics report: aggregated per-tenant counts and rates over a reporting period, derived from ShadowRun records. Rates are fractions in [0, 1]; autoExecuteRate + approvalRate + blockRate SHOULD sum to 1 over the same population.
